notes: In 'the selfsame day' the one written 'the' goes to the article on the rectum s016, since the rectum's own word carries no determiner (rule 29); the demonstrative s019 and its agreement article s018 are unrendered. 'selfsame' cannot absorb `זֶה` under rule 30, because `הַיּוֹם` stands between them and contiguity is that rule's condition.
'unleavened cakes' and 'parched grain' head on the lexeme-bearing word by rule 31's subtraction test: 'cakes' and 'grain' alone are any cakes and any grain.
